assessment.title: Player falls through seam between adjacent solid floor tiles
assessment.playerImpact: Observed: player drops 0.6 units (exceeds 0.4 threshold) from Y=1.0 to Y=0.4 in one step, gains downward velocity -3.34, loses grounded state while positioned over solid floor-4-1 (top at Y=0.12). Player center at Y=0.4 implies player bottom ~Y=-0.1 (assuming height 1.0), intersecting floor volume. Possible: fall damage, death if over void, or progression block until reset.
assessment.rationale: At step -11 player stands on floor-4-2 (Z=-2.81) grounded. Step -10 moves south to Z=-4.4, which lies on adjacent floor-4-1 (Z range -5 to -3, solid=true in both before/after states). Despite floor-4-1 being present and solid at the new position, player becomes ungrounded with large downward velocity, sinking into the floor tile. Reset at step -9 recovers. This indicates a collision detection failure at the tile boundary.
